City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.

2.

3.

4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS - NONE
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-09-18 Item 08A Warrants
8B.
Notice of Completion for Cardiff Accessibility Improvements Project (CS18H) Contact Person: Engineer Milligan
1) Accept public improvements as complete; 2) Authorize release of performance bond and initiate warranty bond; and 3) Authorize filing of Notice of Completion.
2019-09-18 Item 08B Cardiff Accessibility Improvements (CS18H) Notice of Completion
8C.
Introduction of Ordinance 2019-19 Establishing New Speed Limits on portions of Vulcan Avenue, San Elijo Avenue, and Santa Fe Drive. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Introduce Ordinance 2019-19 titled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limits on portions of Vulcan Avenue, San Elijo Avenue, and Santa Fe Drive” including the Engineering and Traffic Survey.
2019-09-18 Item 08C Speed Survey - Vulcan San Elijo
8D.
Second reading of City Council Ordinance No. 2019-18 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas authorizing the Implementation of a Community Choice Aggregation Program.” Contact Person: CAP Program Administrator Najera
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2019-18 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas authorizing the Implementation of a Community Choice Aggregation Program.”
2019-09-18 Item 08D CCE JPA Ordinance
8E.
Contract Extension with JEDA Works DBA Housing Programs for Administration of City Residential Rehabilitation Program. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney to execute a contract extension, in substantial form with JEDA Works DBA Housing Programs (Housing Programs) to: 1) Extend the term of the existing contract for a nine-month period, from October 3, 2019 to June 30, 2020 and include an option to extend the term an additional one-year period; and 2) Add clarifying language related to funding available through the annual allocation process. All other contract provisions remain in place.
2019-09-18 Item 08E Residential Rehabilitation Program Contract Amendment
8F.
Review and approval, in substantial form, of a Professional Services Agreement between the City of Encinitas and Kimley-Horn and Associates, Inc., in an amount not to exceed $177,840, to complete the 6th Cycle Housing Element Update; and authorize the City Manager to enter into the agreement for said services. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Approve the Professional Services Agreement between the City of Encinitas and Kimley-Horn and Associates, Inc. (Attachment 1), in substantial form, and authorize the City Manager to execute the same, subject to the review and final approval of the City Attorney.
2019-09-18 Item 08F Housing Element Cycle 6 Update Contract Approval
8G.
Fiscal Year 2018-19 Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report (CAPER) for the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
1) Approve the Fiscal Year 2018-19 CAPER; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to submit the CAPER to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD).
2019-09-18 Item 08G Consolidated Annual Performance & Evaluation Report CDBG
2019-09-18 Item 08G Consolidated Annual Performance & Evaluation Report CDBG Attachment 1 - Corrected 9-18-19
8H.
Treasurer’s Annual Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2019 and Investment Policy. Contact Person: Director of Finance/City Treasurer McBroome
1) Receive and file the Treasurer’s Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2019; and 2) Adopt Investment Policy (F019).
2019-09-18 Item 08H Treasurer's Annual Report and Investment Policy Update
8I.
Authorization to solicit bids for the Conservation Demonstration Garden at the Public Works Operations Center (Project) and approval of the following items necessary for Grant funding the implementation of the Project: Adoption of Resolution 2019-63 to adopt the 2013 San Diego Integrated Regional Water Management Plan (IRWM) for grant funding; and Authorization to enter into a Local Project Participant (LPP) agreement with San Elijo Joint Powers Authority (SEJPA) for grant funding. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
1) Approve the Project plans and specifications; 2) Authorize solicitation of construction bids; 3) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to enter into a LPP Agreement with SEJPA for the Proposition 84 IRWM Grant Program; 4) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-63, entitled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Adopting the 2013 San Diego Integrated Regional Water Management Plan" (IRWM); and 5) Accept the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) findings for the Project (exempt).
2019-09-18 Item 08I Demonstration Garden

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
